Microneedling for Hair Loss – A Technique We Helped Bring into Mainstream Trichology

Did you know that our team was among the first to publish clinical research demonstrating the benefits of microneedling in androgenetic alopecia?

Our landmark study showed that microneedling can be an effective adjunct to conventional hair loss treatments, opening new possibilities for patients struggling with hair thinning and hair loss.

Hair loss treatment is not one-size-fits-all. A detailed scalp evaluation is essential before choosing the right treatment plan.

Pleased to share our recently published work evaluating the effect of combining anthralin with systemic steroids in a patient with alopecia totalis.

Dr. Rachita Dhurat & Dr. Richa Sharma

How Long Should Hair Loss Medicines Be Continued?

One of the most common questions patients ask is: "When can I stop my hair-loss medicines?"

The answer depends on the cause of hair loss.

For conditions such as androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss), treatment often needs to be continued long-term to maintain results. Stopping treatment may lead to gradual loss of the benefits achieved.

Hair-loss treatment is not the same for every patient. The duration and type of treatment should be individualized based on the diagnosis, severity of hair loss, and treatment response.
